question:
Percentage distribution of Six different types of Trucks manufactured by a Company over Two Years is shown below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e685450447527488a82842b7cf6fe73f54a8bbbfe7ea3b63e0301ec2b7e6cfc5.png] 

How much more is the actual distribution of Truck Q in the year 2023 as compared to 2022?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Difference between truck Q in year 2023 to 2022 is given by,

⇒ (20% of 375000) - (15% of 350000)

⇒ 75000 - 52500 = 22500

**∴ Truck Q in 2023 as compared to 2022 is 22500 more.**
